default.shell:
---

{{ if and (eq .Vars.win19cis_system_role "domaincontroller") .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_2_3_5_4 }}
    {{ if eq .Vars.win19cis_system_role "domaincontroller" }}
registry:
  HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters\LDAPServerIntegrity:
    title: "2.3.5.4 | Ensure 'Domain controller: LDAP server signing requirements' is set to 'Require signing' (DC only) | LDAPServerIntegrity"
    exists: true
    value: 2
    type: REG_DWORD
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.5.4
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-17(2)
        - IA-5
        - IA-5(1)
        - SC-8
        - SC-8(1)
    {{ end }}
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.5.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.5/cis_2.3.5.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Domain Controller only (from the upstream task name).

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.5.4 | PATCH | Ensure Domain controller LDAP server signing requirements is set to Require signing DC only | Domain Controller"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_2_3_5_4
    - prelim_win19cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - rule_2.3.5.4
    - patch
    - ldap
    - NIST800-171_3.1.13
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-171_3.13.8
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-17_2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-8
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-8_1
  block:
    - name: "2.3.5.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Domain controller LDAP server signing requirements is set to Require signing DC only | Warning Msg For Domain Policy Owned Setting"
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! This setting is owned by Group Policy on a domain controller. The Default"
          - "Domain Controllers Policy pins LDAPServerIntegrity to 1, and a domain controller"
          - "refreshes policy every 5 minutes, so a local registry write is reverted before it"
          - "takes effect. Set 'Domain controller: LDAP server signing requirements' to 'Require"
          - "signing' in that policy."

    - name: "2.3.5.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Domain controller LDAP server signing requirements is set to Require signing DC only | Add Warn Count"
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.5.4'
